summary:
A fuel truck overturned and caught fire on a busy highway near Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, Egypt's health ministry said. At least 21 others were injured, and dozens of ambulances responded to the crash on the packed Ring Road in Giza. Health authorities say the death toll could rise. The fire broke out after the fuel truck reportedly overturned. The suspected driver was arrested on Thursday, according to Egypt's public prosecutor's office.

US President Donald Trump has unveiled new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including China, Japan and the European Union. Trump is targeting China, the European Union and 12 other jurisdictions. The measures target what the administration calls unfair industrial capacity, and were announced on Wednesday. Trump proceeded despite the losses his Republican Party suffered in the US midterm elections, and the tariffs are part of his protectionist push.

The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has reached 12,000 cases, and some responders are evacuating. The fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, and fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the disease.

headlines.title: UK net migration falls to 77,000, lowest since 1997
headlines.summary: Net migration to the UK fell to 77,000 in the year to June, the lowest annual figure since 1997 excluding the Covid years, statistics showed on Thursday. The drop was largely driven by fewer people arriving from outside the European Union.

headlines.title: Myanmar says it will not comply with parts of genocide ruling
headlines.summary: Myanmar's leader said the country will not comply with 'inappropriate' parts of the International Court of Justice's genocide ruling. The court last week laid out evidence of atrocities against the Rohingya during a 2017 crackdown.

headlines.title: Hong Kong marks one year since Tai Po fire that killed 168
headlines.summary: Residents quietly mourned the 168 people killed in the blaze at Wang Fuk Court residential complex in Tai Po a year ago. Officials warned against using the disaster to sow division.

headlines.title: Trump administration approves SpaceX plan for 1 million satellites
headlines.summary: The Trump administration gave SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space. Scientists have raised skepticism about the move.
